simulation_rules.name: BRS/FM1/inv stoppage
simulation_rules.natural_text: If the BRS/FM01 stops due to high inventory levels it should stay stopped long enough to prevent from stopping again in the future, without compromise the cement inventory

simulation_rules.name: Minimum running time
simulation_rules.natural_text: The minimum campaing should be two days per product to ensure quality. Just when no other choice is available we should program one day.

simulation_rules.name: Rule 3
simulation_rules.natural_text: alternate campaings between MIA/IL(11) and MIA/SPC one week each
